caption: #Ad  Would you put an entire avocado into chocolate muffins? 🥑🍫 Research has shown that as kids get older, they tend to eat fewer fruits and vegetables. Fresh avocados are one simple and delicious way to include more fruit in back-to-school meals and snacks.  Today I’m partnering with @aguacatesloveonetoday to make these Avocado Chocolate Muffins have become one of my favorite make-ahead snacks for busy school weeks. Fresh avocados are the star of this recipe, creating an incredibly soft, rich texture while contributing healthy unsaturated fats, fiber and more than 20 vitamins and minerals. Recipe Ingredients ● 1 ripe avocado ● ½ cup all purpose flour or oat flour ● 2 eggs ● ⅓ cup peanut butter ● ⅓ cup maple syrup ● ⅓ cup cocoa powder ● 1 tsp vanilla extract ● 1 tsp baking powder ● Handful of chocolate chips Directions 1. If using oat flour, blend the oats into a fine flour. 2. Add the avocado and all remaining ingredients except the chocolate chips, then blend until smooth. 3. Fold in the chocolate chips. 4. Pour into a greased muffin tin. 5. Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes. 6. Let cool completely before serving. Have you ever baked with avocado before? @Aguacates - Love One Today #loveonetoday
